profile.name: Md Manowar Hashmi
profile.title: UI / Frontend Developer
profile.tagline: UI / Frontend Developer building clean, responsive, data-driven interfaces — 8+ years turning specs and designs into interfaces people actually enjoy using.

summaryParagraphs: I'm a UI/Frontend developer with 8+ years of experience building responsive, user-friendly web applications — mainly with React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML and CSS/SCSS, backed by REST APIs.

Over the years I've worked across different kinds of web projects, from building sites from scratch to developing and maintaining enterprise applications with complex, data-driven screens. I care most about clean UI, responsive design, performance, and keeping the experience consistent across a product — and I'm always looking for the next hard frontend problem to learn from.

bullets: Architected and optimized virtualized enterprise data grids using React and TypeScript, managing dynamic datasets with 10k+ records and improving UI render speed by 35%.

Engineered responsive, modular UI features for financial streaming (Alphastream), legal documentation (Bond Covenant UI, Ares) and project management platforms, driving a 30% increase in user satisfaction.
Reduced production regression defects by establishing unit and component testing suites using Jest and React Testing Library for critical UI components.
Improved initial page load and Core Web Vitals by 25% through dynamic code-splitting, lazy loading, and asset optimization in Vite.
Collaborated with cross-functional product, UX, and QA teams to translate Figma wireframes into accessible, production-ready design system components.
Developed responsive web applications using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap, and MVC.
Built user-friendly interfaces based on business requirements and design specifications.
Integrated APIs and dynamic data into production web applications.
Delivered 100+ client websites, applying on-page SEO and keyword optimization to improve search rankings.
Improved existing applications for usability, responsiveness, and performance.
Developed responsive websites and web interfaces using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Bootstrap.
Owned UI design, development, maintenance, and improvements across multiple client projects.
Focused on responsive layouts, usability, and cross-browser compatibility.
Translated client requirements and designs into functional interfaces.

project.name: Hash Playground
project.description: A browser-based coding platform I designed and built end to end — write, run, and version React + TypeScript or HTML/CSS/JS projects entirely in the browser, no installs, no setup. React/TypeScript frontend, Fastify/Prisma/PostgreSQL backend, deployed and live.
project.note: Designed and built solo — pairing with AI-assisted development tooling for backend work and iteration speed, while owning the UI, UX, and product decisions myself.
features: Monaco-powered multi-file editor with tabs, Quick Open, and a live sandboxed preview
Instant npm package resolution at run time — no build or install step
Git-style version history with per-file diffing and rollback
Style-template scaffolding (Bootstrap / Tailwind), image uploads, one-click project export
Google, GitHub & LinkedIn OAuth, plus email/phone auth with strict duplicate-account checks
Role-based admin tools, including a request-and-approve workflow for admin-assisted updates
